### Findings refused

- Unit 7 · l/i · ታቦተ ሕጉ rendered 'the-law', not 'his-law': refused. The published pilot (ch. 1) renders the same phrase 'ark-of the-law of-God' in l and 'the Ark of the Law of God' in i; the pronoun is the anticipatory -ሁ, as the glossary entry says.
- Unit 18 vs 23 · ሐመደ 'ashes' (18) against 'dust' (23): refused. ሐመድ covers both; ashes on the head is the mourning gesture, 'taste dust' follows the psalm allusion. Published ch. 27 glosses it 'dust, ashes'.
- Unit 23 · ይቀምሑ 'they will taste': not changed. I cannot confirm ቀመሐ as 'taste' against 'lick' without Dillmann; left as the drafter had it, with no hedge added because l and i agree and the allusion note is general. Worth a (?) if Dillmann becomes available.
- Unit 5 · ንቱግ, ፀዋግ, መስተቀይም, ምዑዕ: the drafter's guesses were kept (hedged), since I have no better evidence; only the unsupported 'dweller-apart' was removed. Unit 21's ነቢር 'dwelling, settled' kept as hedged.
- Unit 13 · ቲሆሙ, unit 11 · ቊስቋሳት, unit 12 · መሐዛት, unit 17 · ቀልዐ, unit 19 · ሰእለ, unit 20 · ሴልየ, unit 7 · ዘእቱት: all left unresolved and hedged; I cannot supply a reading.
- Unit 1 · 'ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ' note calling it 'construct': kept; the known-form entry says the same and the chain 'king-of Ethiopia' is right.
- Unit 3 · note's allusion to Genesis 22:17 and Genesis 28: kept; the chronicle's wording draws on both blessings, and the note is general.
- Unit 4 · ስፍሓ 'breadth' (?): kept as hedged by the drafter; the note's comparison to Genesis 27:28 is a scriptural allusion, not a modern translation.
- Unit 2 · አኀዘ ርእሶ: the drafter's hedged double reading kept.
- Unit 10 · note's 'ፎ marks the pause' placement: kept; harmless.
- Unit 20 · 'my belly burns' for ውዕየት (perfect): kept; a resultative present is acceptable in English.
- Unit 24 · 'in another place' for ወበካልእኒ: kept; the note says 'another (psalm)'.
- Unit 14 · 'ዘትበኪ … wept' tense: kept as a past-habitual of the imperfect; added the grammar to the note only.
- Heading units 0 and 9 · 'Where …': kept; ኀበ 'where' is the established reading in the note and the headings are in the book's formula.
